name: Erse the Mural (Kim Gardner)
statement:
I'm Erse (Erse the Mural), a Sacramento, California mural artist working in aerosol and acrylic at large scale. My work blends graffiti-influenced lettering with realism, built for public space — bold from across the street, detailed up close.

The through-line in my practice is community-built walls. I was lead artist on the 160-foot "Welcome to Citrus Heights" wall, painted with more than 50 community volunteers and covered by the local press; through Blue Line Arts I painted an elementary school wall alongside its students; and I contributed to a 150-by-50-foot unity mural at Lower Lake High School with fellow artists Shane Grammer and MAMMXTH. I know how to design a wall many hands can help bring to life — and how to finish it to a professional standard.

NewBo City Market is exactly the kind of wall I want to paint: a working food hall at the center of a district with a real history. I'd bring that same community-first process to Cedar Rapids, and I'm available for the December–February installation window.
